summary: A new admin gets the first Temporary Access Pass straight away instead of up to half an hour later.

fixes.title: The first Temporary Access Pass arrives immediately
fixes.text: A new admin's first pass was delayed 10 to 30 minutes because Entra ID needs a few seconds after creating the account. PIM Manager now waits briefly and retries in the same run.

fixes.title: Server onboarding without a hybrid worker
fixes.text: Without a hybrid worker and no groups marked for Active Directory, server onboarding no longer shows "not implemented". It reports that there is nothing to onboard.
